purpose: Isolated binding candidates; absence of a descriptor never means zero effect.
scenario_policy: Apply only when source scenario matches selected game mode; RaidZone values require separate validation.

catalog.version: March 2026 community snapshot; not current verification

treacherous_preview.note: Article explicitly says values are for testing.

thresholds.legacy_text: Get Bullet Saver effect with every precise kill, Weakspot DMG +15% for 8s. Effect can stack up to 3 times.
After killing an enemy, gain Reload Efficiency +20%. If it is a Weakspot kill, also gain Fire Rate +10%. Lasts until you reload.
When HP is above 70%, Weapon DMG +10%

Stay crouched and immobile for 0.5s to enter the Bastille state. While in the Bastille state, gain Weapon DMG +40%. After exiting the Bastille state, you cannot sprint and your Stamina consumption is increased by 100% for 3s.
3s after exiting Bastille state, gain 1 stack of Armor per second, up to 60 stacks. While in Bastille state, each stack of Armor provides a Shield equal to 1% of max HP.
Upon dealing Elemental DMG, gain 1 stack(s) of Warm Sensation (Elemental DMG +2%) for 2s. Triggers 1 time every 0.5s, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
When the temperature is between 10°C and 30°C, you gain the Warm status (Elemental DMG +18%).
At 5 stacks of Warm Sensation, you are considered to be in the Warm status. When the environmental temperature is between 10°C and 30°C, gain Elemental DMG +7%.
Upon dealing Elemental DMG, gain 1 stack(s) of Warm Sensation (Elemental DMG +2%) for 2s. Triggers 1 time every 0.5s, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
When the temperature is below 10°C, you gain Cold status (Elemental DMG +10%). For every additional degree below that, gain Elemental DMG +0.5%, up to 20%.
At 5 stacks of Warm Sensation, the environmental temperature drops by 5°C, the DMG bonus provided by the Cold status is doubled, and its cap is increased to 40%.
Upon dealing Elemental DMG, gain 1 stack(s) of Warm Sensation (Elemental DMG +2%) for 2s. Triggers 1 time every 0.5s, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
When the temperature is above 30°C, you gain Passion status (Elemental DMG +10%). For every additional degree above that, gain Elemental DMG +0.5%, up to 20%.
At 5 stacks of Warm Sensation, the environmental temperature rises by 5°C, the DMG bonus provided by the Passion status is doubled, and its cap is increased to 40%.
After using Melee attack to Kill an enemy, instantly gain 5 Prime Energy, and increase DMG of your next Melee attack by 20% within 5 seconds.
Melee kill an enemy to instantly recover 30 Stamina and increase Movement Speed by 20% for 2s (cooldown: 3s).
When Stamina is over 90%, increase Crit Rate by 5% and Crit DMG by 20%.
After killing an enemy, immediately recover 30 Stamina and gain 20% increased Movement Speed for 2s. Cooldown: 3s.
After killing an enemy, increase Movement Speed by 20% for 2s and Elemental DMG (Blaze, Frost, Shock, Blast) by 40%, decay over 8s.
Within 5m, each enemy grants you DMG Reduction +4%. Effect can stack up to 4 times.
Gain 1 stack of Lone Shadow for every 4 Crit shots landed with a weapon. Lone Shadow: Crit DMG +6% for 20s, stacking up to 8 times.
Increases maximum Lonewolf stacks to 10. After reloading, gain Crit Rate +10% for 2s.
When the load is over 80, DMG taken -10%, Weapon and Tactical Item DMG +15%
Stamina cost -30% when gliding and rolling
Gain 1 stack of Archer's Focus upon hitting the same enemy consecutively. Archer's Focus: Weakspot DMG +4%, stacking up to 10 times. Archer's Focus stacks are halved upon changing targets.
When reloading, for every 1% of shots from the previous magazine that were Weakspot hits, load an extra 0.6% ammunition, capped at an extra 30%.

descriptors.note: Do not confuse shield amount with shield capacity.

thresholds.note: Release says the normal trigger does not occur if shield exceeds 40%; later update adds refresh behavior while shield stays above 40%. Exact boundary and durations still need current tooltip verification.

thresholds.legacy_text: Weapon and Tactical Item DMG +20% when not spotted by enemies
Sprint Speed +12% and Stamina Recovery Speed +20% when HP is below 50%

Each weapon hit grants 1 stack of Deviant Energy. Every stack of Deviant Energy grants 1% Elemental DMG (Blaze, Frost, Shock, Blast). Effect can stack up to 20 times. Reloading removes half of the total stacks.
Increase max Deviant Energy stack by 10. Grant 2 additional stacks when hitting a weakspot.
Taking DMG grants a stack of Powered Armor, DMG Reduction +4% for 10s. Effect can stack up to 6 times.
Rolling consumes 3 stacks of Powered Armor and triggers an explosion that knocks back surrounding enemies. For each enemy hit, HP +5%, up to 20% (cooldown: 10s).

integration_rules: Never calculate catalog_hint_only, official_preview_only, historical_official_qualitative or unverified records as current numeric fact.
Distinguish shield_generation, shield_restoration, shield_capacity, and shield mitigation.
Process trigger_duplication without emitting a second Frost Vortex or re-entering its own trigger.
A None magnitude is unknown, not zero.
Set thresholds are cumulative; count distinct equipped pieces belonging to that set, never duplicate a slot.
